# Standalone checks

:::caution[v3 release candidate, unreleased]

This is the reference for `@obolnetwork/obol-sdk@3.0.0-rc.12`, generated from its source and spec. Names and shapes may still change before 3.0.0, and it is not on npm `latest`. For the released SDK see the [2.x reference](../../sdk/index.md).

:::

Root exports that need no client, for servers that verify what users send them (the Obol API uses them): `isValidLock` (a boolean; [`cluster.verifyLock`](./cluster.md#verifyLock) returns the failing step), `isValidTypedDataSignature` (an EIP-712 bearer signature from an account or, through EIP-1271, a Safe), and the error helpers. On a Node server pass the native BLS backend from `@obolnetwork/obol-sdk/blst`.

## Checks {#group-checks}

### isValidLock {#isValidLock}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag" title="Where it reads from (spec tag)">pure (chain as verifyLock)</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--pure" title="Exported from the namespace, not bound on the client">namespace only</span></div>

isValidLock (pure; `chain` for a contract-wallet signer): `verifyLock` as
a boolean, the drop-in for the 2.x `validateClusterLock`. Runs at
`level: 'full'` unless `options.level` says otherwise (a server that
accepts locks must keep `full`), with the other options passed through
(`bls`, `publicClient` / `publicClients`, `yieldMs`, `signal`). A
malformed lock ([`PAYLOAD_INVALID`](../errors.md#PAYLOAD_INVALID)) is `false`, as in 2.x; any other error
is thrown, including [`ABORTED`](../errors.md#ABORTED) from `signal` (never `false`).

```ts sdk-signature
isValidLock(
  lock: unknown,
  options?: VerifyLockOptions,
): Promise<boolean>
```

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--fields">

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <code>lock</code> | <span class="sdk-type">unknown</span> |  |
| <code>options?</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/cluster#VerifyLockOptions">VerifyLockOptions</a></span> |  |
| <code>options.publicClient?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">PublicClient</span> | A client for contract-wallet (EIP-1271) definition signatures, such as a Safe creator: used for a lock on its own chain only. The SDK has no RPCs of its own (2.x had built-in ones). See `publicClients`. |
| <code>options.publicClients?</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/checks#PublicClients">PublicClients</a></span> | Clients by chain id (or a function of the chain id), for a caller that verifies locks of several chains: the one for the lock's chain (from its `fork_version`) checks contract-wallet signatures. Without a client for that chain, a definition signature that does not recover to its signer fails as `definition_signature_unverifiable`. |
| <code>options.level?</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/cluster#LockVerificationLevel">LockVerificationLevel</a></span> | Default `full`. |
| <code>options.signatures?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">'all' &#124; 'none' &#124; number[]</span> | Validators (indexes in the lock) whose deposit and builder registration BLS signatures `attested` checks: `all`, `none` (default) or a list. `full` checks all of them (only `all` is accepted with it). |
| <code>options.yieldMs?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">number</span> | Longest stretch of work, in ms, between yields to the event loop (default 50; 0 = never yield). A stretch can overrun it by one unit of work (one signature, about 25 ms with the default backend). |
| <code>options.bls?</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/checks#BlsBackend">BlsBackend</a></span> | BLS backend (default `nobleBls`, pure JavaScript). |
| <code>options.signal?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">AbortSignal</span> | Aborts the verification: checked at every yield point (between units of work), and an abort throws [`ABORTED`](../errors.md#ABORTED) with the signal's reason as `cause`. The way for a server to bound the CPU spent per request, e.g. `AbortSignal.timeout(10_000)`. With `yieldMs: 0` the event loop never runs during the call, so a timer cannot fire mid-run. |

</div>

**Returns** <span class="sdk-type">Promise&lt;boolean&gt;</span>

**Example**

```ts
import { isValidLock } from '@obolnetwork/obol-sdk';
import { loadBlstBackend } from '@obolnetwork/obol-sdk/blst';

const bls = await loadBlstBackend(); // once, at boot (Node)
const valid = await isValidLock(lock, {
  bls,
  publicClients: { 1: mainnetClient, 560048: hoodiClient }, // Safe-signed definitions
  signal: AbortSignal.timeout(10_000), // throws ABORTED after 10 s
});
```

<details class="sdk-spec">
<summary>Specification: cluster.isValidLock</summary>

Tag: `pure` (`chain` as `verifyLock`). Inputs: a lock, the `verifyLock` options. Output: `bool`. The 2.x
`validateClusterLock`. Runs `verifyLock` with `level: "full"` unless `options.level` is given, and returns `ok`. A
[`PAYLOAD_INVALID`](../errors.md#PAYLOAD_INVALID) for the lock (a malformed lock; issue paths under `lock`) is `false`, as 2.x returned; one for the
options (paths under `options`) and every other error are thrown, including [`ABORTED`](../errors.md#ABORTED) from `signal` (an abort is
never `false`). Also a root export and bound
([`obol.cluster.isValidLock`](./cluster.md#isValidLock), with the client's `publicClient` for its chain). (new in 3.0.0-rc.5)

### isValidTypedDataSignature {#isValidTypedDataSignature}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag" title="Where it reads from (spec tag)">pure (chain for a contract-wallet signer)</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--pure" title="Exported from the namespace, not bound on the client">namespace only</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--since" title="Renamed in 3.0.0-rc.12">rc.12: was verifyTypedDataSignature</span></div>

isValidTypedDataSignature (pure; `chain` for a contract-wallet signer):
whether `signature` is `address`'s EIP-712 signature of `typedData`, by
ECDSA recovery or, for a contract wallet such as a Safe, EIP-1271
`isValidSignature` (also the legacy `isValidSignature(bytes, bytes)` →
`0x20c13b0b` of Safes before 1.3.0, as 2.x accepted). The 2.x `validateAddressSignature` /
`validateEOASignature`.

**Contract wallets need a client for their chain.** 2.x fell back to
built-in RPCs; v3 has none. Pass `publicClients` (by chain id) or a
`publicClient` on `chainId` (default: the domain's `chainId`). Without
one, a signature that does not recover to `address` is `false`, even if
`address` is a Safe that would accept it.

`typedData` is viem's shape (`domain`, `types`, `primaryType`,
`message`); an `EIP712Domain` entry in `types` is accepted, and so is
eth-sig-util's `TypedMessage` (a bytes `salt` is converted to hex). Never
throws: a malformed signature or typed data is `false` (2.x threw on a
malformed signature).

```ts sdk-signature
isValidTypedDataSignature(
  __0: {
    address: string;
    signature: string;
    typedData: EIP712TypedData;
    /** Chain of a contract-wallet signer; default `typedData.domain.chainId`. */
    chainId?: number;
  } & SignatureClients,
): Promise<boolean>
```

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--fields">

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <code>__0</code> | <span class="sdk-type">{ address: string; signature: string; typedData: <a href="./types/checks#EIP712TypedData">EIP712TypedData</a>; chainId?: number; } &amp; <a href="./types/checks#SignatureClients">SignatureClients</a></span> |  |

</div>

**Returns** <span class="sdk-type">Promise&lt;boolean&gt;</span>

**Example**

```ts
import { isValidTypedDataSignature, cluster } from '@obolnetwork/obol-sdk';

const ok = await isValidTypedDataSignature({
  address: account,
  signature: '0x…' as string,
  typedData: cluster.enrTypedData(enr, 560048),
  publicClients: { 560048: hoodiClient }, // needed when the signer is a Safe
});
```

<details class="sdk-spec">
<summary>Specification: isValidTypedDataSignature</summary>

Named `verifyTypedDataSignature` until 3.0.0-rc.12: it returns a boolean, like `isValidLock`.

Tag: `pure` (`chain` for a contract-wallet signer). Inputs: `{ address, signature, typedData: { domain?, types,
primaryType, message }, chainId?: uint, publicClient?, publicClients? }`. Output: `bool`. The 2.x
`validateAddressSignature` / `validateEOASignature`: `true` iff `signature` recovers to `address` (ECDSA over
`hashTypedData`), or, with a client for `chainId` (default `typedData.domain.chainId`; a domain without `chainId`,
such as the terms, needs `chainId` for a contract wallet), `address` is a contract whose EIP-1271
`isValidSignature` accepts it (current or legacy magic, as in "Contract-wallet signatures" above). An `EIP712Domain`
entry in `types` is accepted, and so is eth-sig-util's `TypedMessage`: `domain.salt` may be bytes (`ArrayBuffer` or a
typed array; converted to hex), `domain.verifyingContract` any string, `primaryType` a number (read as a string).
Never throws (a malformed signature or typed data is `false`; 2.x threw on a malformed signature). Without a client,
a contract wallet's signature is `false`. (new in 3.0.0-rc.5; legacy magic and `TypedMessage` in rc.6)

</details>

## Pure helpers {#group-helpers}

### isObolError {#isObolError}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--pure" title="Exported from the namespace, not bound on the client">namespace only</span></div>

Whether `error` is an ObolError (with `code`, of that code). With a code,
`details` narrows to that code's fields:

  if (isObolError(e, 'TX_UNCONFIRMED')) watch(e.details.hash)

Works across copies of the SDK (an error thrown by the CommonJS build is
recognised by the ESM build, and by another installed version): it checks
a `Symbol.for` brand and a string `code`, not `instanceof`.

```ts sdk-signature
isObolError<C extends ObolErrorCode>(
  error: unknown,
  code: C,
): error is ObolError<C>

isObolError(
  error: unknown,
): error is ObolError
```

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--fields">

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <code>error</code> | <span class="sdk-type">unknown</span> |  |
| <code>code</code> | <span class="sdk-type">C</span> |  |

</div>

**Returns** <span class="sdk-type">error is <a href="./types/core#ObolError">ObolError</a>&lt;C&gt;</span>

**Example**

```ts
import { isObolError } from '@obolnetwork/obol-sdk';

try {
  await obol.deposits.fromLock(lock);
} catch (error) {
  if (isObolError(error, 'DEPOSIT_AMOUNT_REQUIRED')) {
    console.log('pick one of', error.details.available); // typed per code
  } else throw error;
}
```
